usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I added the discounts. Premium customers get 5% off and nonprofit customers get 10% off (DEC-B06/B07). The invoiced amount is what `show`, balances and late fees now use. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (13/13), and the work and report are committed.
One gap is still open: neither decision says what a customer who is both premium and nonprofit gets (c4). For now `invoice` refuses them with an `error:` line, which also means they can no longer be invoiced at the full amount as before. Finance needs to decide this; it is in the report's open questions.
I also chose that a discount that rounds to 0.00 keeps the old output, and recorded that choice.

OUTCOME: completed
